newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila gives derivatives licences to two banks.
newsitem.headline: Manila gives derivatives licences to two banks.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank has given licences to Far East Bank and Trust Co Inc and Bank of America's Manila branch to trade derivatives, sources in the central bank said on Thursday.
The Central Bank earlier gave its approval for the Philippine branches of Citibank NA and Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank Corp to trade the hedging instruments.

The Central Bank regulates the growth of derivatives trading by limiting players to those who pass its requirements, which include stipulations that traders should have adequate training and experience.
